results.title: Agibank Named Official Lead Sponsor for Legendary Brazilian Club Santos FC
results.description: SÃO PAULO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Agibank today was announced as the official lead sponsor for Brazilian soccer club Santos Futebol Clube. The agreement is valid through the end of the 2026 season, and the Agibank brand will occupy the primary space on the front of the men's team jerseys. The sponsorship is set to debut this Sunday, October 18, in the match against Fluminense at the Maracanã. Agibank is a subsidiary of Agi Inc. (NYSE: AGBK) (“Agi”).
